title: Concept: Spring Actuator environment dump
description: A Spring Actuator environment document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The dump lists every property source the application resolved, including datasource URLs and the values of unencrypted credentials, and it is served unauthenticated by default.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator environment document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The dump lists every property source the application resolved, including datasource URLs and the values of unencrypted credentials, and it is served unauthenticated by default.
